name: CETC Digital Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: CETC Digital Technology Co.,Ltd. is a specialist provider of software and information technology solutions. Its diverse portfolio includes advanced data center cooling systems, intelligent conference and software management platforms, and comprehensive operational and maintenance solutions. Furthermore, the company delivers a variety of IT value-added services. The company also offers a robust suite of cloud computing products. These encompass server virtualization capabilities, enterprise cloud storage solutions, cloud resource and service management tools, and cloud desktop environments. CETC Digital Technology caters to a broad spectrum of sectors, serving governmental bodies, educational institutions, financial services, telecommunications, manufacturing, energy, and transportation industries. Established in Shanghai, China, in 1993, the company previously operated under the name Shanghai East-China Computer Co.,Ltd.
